title: eludite/project/setItemProperties
description: Brief 0081: change a file's Build Action (item type) and metadata (Copy to Output Directory, Custom Tool, Custom Tool Namespace) in its project file, preserving formatting as eludite/project/setProperty does (Microsoft.Build.Construction): an item included by name is changed in place (its element renamed for a new item type, its metadata elements added, changed or removed); a file of the SDK's default globs gets an Update item (<None Update="x" CopyToOutputDirectory="..."/> style metadata elements) for metadata, and for a new item type a Remove from the old type plus an Include of the new type, in an item group of their own. A value equal to the default removes the metadata element. The host then reloads the solution.

generation.description: The generation the shell read the tree under. Not the current generation: -32801 (ContentModified), nothing written.
The generation after the call: one more than the request's when a file was written (the host reloaded the solution), else the same.
